27611.d: Tortle Combat (miniquest) is a miniquest made by the Ninja Team to celebrate the team's 1 year anniversary of existing again.

gt.heading: Entering the sewers
gt.text:
Talk to Postie Pete-za by the entrance to Varrock Sewers. He will ask you to deliver a pizza to Wolfgang in the sewer. Open the nearby manhole cover and climb down the ladder into the sewers. Head east and squeeze through the pipe. Wolfgang the tortle can be found on a wooden bridge along with 4 more nearby tortles. 

Talking with Wolfgang will result in you giving him the pizza. Wolfgang will tell you and you will see cutscenes showing that they were trapped on one of the islands of the Eastern Lands by Tortletrapper13224, then teleported to the Abyss, and then to the sewer. Now he asks you to help them develop their agility and speed as well as to arm them.

27668.d: The Tower of Life is a tower south of Ardougne which features prominently in the Tower of Life quest.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
The Tower of Life is found south of East Ardougne. It can be easily accessed using:
• Using Ardougne cloak or Kandarin monastery Teleport, you can teleport to the nearby Monastery which is a short walk from the tower.
• Ardougne Teleport brings you to the East Ardougne marketplace, with the tower to the south.
• Fairy ring DJP brings you right next to the tower. Use of fairy rings requires partial completion of the quest A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen.

The closest bank without using teleportation is the one south of the marketplace in East Ardougne. If players can use fairy rings, then the bank in Zanaris or near TzHaar Fight Cave BLP are closer.
